name: ActionGenerationAgent
description: Converts each BRD-traced test case into grounded, executable browser/HTTP actions on the elements Runtime Discovery found on the live app: Gemini proposes steps by element id, the engine validates them against the inventory, falls back to per-class rules, and completes each plan with login, navigation, required-field test data, trigger, wait, download, evidence capture and a judged assertion.

inputs.name: test_cases
inputs.description: BRD-traced tests with code, input, expected_behavior, variant_type, criterion_code

inputs.name: runtime_profile
inputs.description: RuntimeDiscoveryAgent output (pages, forms, fields, buttons, downloads, chat box, login)

inputs.name: app_classification
inputs.description: AppClassificationAgent output: class(es) and testing strategy

inputs.name: live_credentials
inputs.description: Presence only — decides whether a login wall blocks; never copied into plans

outputs.name: action_plan
outputs.description: status, reason, requires_login, inventory_size, counts, plans[{plan_id, test_id, test_code, criterion_code, class, kind, scored, status, source, reason, steps[]}]
